rubrics.justification: Describes ICM and TE as high quality and notes thinned zona appropriately, but shows uncertainty/possible inconsistency about stage (early-to-mid vs expanded) and adds some features not clearly verifiable from a single static image.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, semen parameters, BMI, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality, though a few points are overstated or loosely connected.

Overall logic is structured and mostly consistent, but there are notable issues such as confusing comments about day-4 kinetics and an odd statement about lower euploid risk in young patients/age 31 that weakens coherence.

Generally aligns with IVF practice: favorable prognosis, eSET in a 27-year-old, luteal support, avoid bed rest, cautious use of PGT-A. Minor deviations include overinterpreting day-4 blastocyst timing and some imprecise counseling language.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, lifestyle, and future evaluation after failure; recommendations are useful though not highly tailored beyond standard IVF management.
